$comment: a7-designation/3: per-invocation designation of an FX-02 VERIFY invocation (the verification, its 16.7 reverification, a negative control) or of the A6-7 measurement under the candidate A7-1 round 3 (I-62 A-7, point 2 (c)): it names the role of every custodied artifact of category (c) (at most one artifact per role) and registers its path and its blob; the rebase record (role REBASE) only in the reverification (Invocation.Kind REVERIFICATION), with its RunId registered. MainSha_eval is derived (K.MainSha, or the MainAfterSha of the rebase record in the reverification), never designated. Part of the construction and validation procedure that A7-1 point 7 names as invalidator (identified by the SHA-256 of this file).
title: a7-designation/3

Kind.$comment: absent = VERIFY; REVERIFICATION = the 16.7 reverification without conflicts (the only kind with a REBASE role); MEASUREMENT = the A6-7 measurement invocation, which produces no verification and has no relay facts (no RELAY role)

RunId.$comment: only for the REBASE role, where it is required (checked by the builder and the validator: the JSON-schema subset of the bench has no conditional keywords): the RunId of the rebase record (16.6), the name of its directory
